eas_text: A civil authority has issued A LAW ENFORCEMENT WARNING for the following counties or areas: Jefferson; Broomfield, CO; at 6:48 PM on AUG 19, 2025 Effective until 7:18 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: The Jefferson County Sheriffs Office has cancelled the previous instructions for Advisory Message due to search for a stabbing suspect in Staunton State Park.  It is now safe to resume normal activities in this area.  Only use 911 if you have an emergency.
